title: Soviet Ukraine missiles enter countdown under disc

tellings.quote: one of them described an incident in Soviet Ukraine where where a huge disc-shaped object a very large object was seen hovering over this missile base in Soviet Ukraine and down in one of the launch capsules uh suddenly the missiles went into countdown mode

plain: In 1982, a huge disc-shaped object is said to have hovered over a Soviet nuclear missile base in Ukraine while, down in a launch capsule, the missiles suddenly went into countdown mode on their own, which would mean the object could reach into nuclear weapons controls. Robert Hastings, a researcher who collects accounts of UFOs at nuclear bases, tells Michels this second-hand, from a source who described the incident and from classified Soviet UFO documents, naming the journalist George Knapp and a man he calls Vladimir Platonoff in the chain.
